note: A waiver is a CEILING, never a mute. It names the code that may rise, how far, why a correct fix makes it rise, and which task repays it. `census_gate.py --prove-waiver` runs the gate twice and fails the lane if the waiver changes no outcome, because a waiver that is not load-bearing is a lie. Integration runs --no-waivers on the merged tree: a lane may borrow, the round must repay. Leave `waivers` empty unless a measured rise forces one.
